title: Void/Decline buttons visible to any user — comment says 'Admin only' but no role check wraps them
detail: Line 182-188 renders the Void and Decline action buttons for every non-terminal contract. The inline comment says 'Void / Decline - Admin only, non-terminal', and line 28 destructures isAdmin, isManager from usePortalUser — but neither variable is ever checked before rendering the buttons.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:28 isAdmin/isManager imported but unused. Line 182-188 btn-void and btn-decline rendered without a guard.

title: reload() contract GET lists dcfg_contract_number twice in the $select clause
detail: Line 48: the $select contains dcfg_contract_number twice. Dataverse tolerates duplicate $select entries but it signals unreviewed concatenation.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:48 apiGet URL — two occurrences of dcfg_contract_number.
recommendedFix: Delete the second dcfg_contract_number from the $select list.

title: reload() error routes to top-level error banner instead of toast — replaces entire page content
detail: Line 60: reload().catch(e => setError(e.message)). setError then causes the whole page to render a warn-banner replacing the contract detail UI.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:60 initial load, 101 commitTransition, 141 render {error} full-page.
recommendedFix: Split into two error paths: hard load failure keeps the banner; transient errors use toast.

title: Modal overlay has no focus trap and no Escape-key dismiss — keyboard users are stranded
detail: Lines 296-336: the transition-confirmation modal is rendered as a fixed overlay with no focus trap, no onKeyDown for Escape, no role='dialog', and no aria-modal='true'. A keyboard-only user who opens any status-change modal may be unable to interact with it or dismiss it.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:296 overlayStyle div — no role, no aria-modal, no onKeyDown for Escape.
recommendedFix: Add role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby pointing to the modal title. Add onKeyDown handler for Escape. Consider a ref-based focus trap.

title: writeAuditLog failure in commitTransition is silently swallowed — audit gap invisible
detail: Line 102: writeAuditLog().catch(e => console.warn()) — if the audit log write fails after a successful status transition, the only signal is a console.warn. For compliance-sensitive contract workflows, a missing audit entry could be material.
recommendedFix: Consider toast.show('warn', 'Status changed but audit log failed') or feed into ErrorReporter.

title: Loading state is a static gray box — no spinner or text indicator
detail: Line 146: loading returns a plain gray div with no text, animation, or ARIA feedback.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:146 — loading returns plain gray div.
recommendedFix: Replace with centered spinner and 'Loading contract...' text.

title: Generate Document button shows 'Generating...' text but is not visually styled as disabled state
detail: Line 168: the button has disabled={generating} but btnPrimary keeps cursor:'pointer' and full opacity. Users may click repeatedly thinking the first click didn't register.
evidence: ContractDetail.jsx:168 — disabled={generating} with static btnPrimary style.
recommendedFix: Add opacity: generating ? 0.6 : 1 and cursor: generating ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer'.

title: Data tables (Exhibit A, Audit Trail) lack scope attributes on th elements
detail: Lines 249 and 276: <th> elements in both tables have no scope='col' attribute — minor WCAG 2.1 gap.
